subject: FB-3b/seaborn: onboard + inject + export KB (ON-self-learning)
description: ONE repo only: mwaskom/seaborn @ 7001ebe7. Clone from GitHub at that commit into /tmp scratch. `node scripts/onboard.js --repo <abs>` (mine→learn). Then `node scripts/onboard-learn.js --repo <abs> --inject --confirm` (inject into seaborn's workspace; verify via search_knowledge). Then `node scripts/export-kb.js --repo <abs> --k 30 --min-score 0.1 > bench/featurebench-kb/seaborn.selflearn.AGENTS.md`. Commit that one file. If KB empty/degenerate, record it. Use onboard.js NOT onboard-loop.js. Context: note-mqfh9nmj87j, pilot-manifest.json.

summary: FB-3b/seaborn KB done. onboard.js OK (14 notes kept / 12 rejected by agentic validation). onboard-learn --inject --confirm injected 14 [ingest] notes into workspace /tmp/fb-seaborn; verified via GET /search?workspace=/tmp/fb-seaborn (count=14, e.g. cubehelix ch: prefix, vendored gaussian_kde, flare/crest colormaps, numpy!=1.24.0 pin).
